Coupled file outside the write set: apps/console/budgets/perf.json segments.l2.tables DOM line 365 -> 500 (measured 458: 336 -> 401 from the walk on the old fixture, 401 -> 458 from the fixture's SEG-01 becoming the shipped table with 15 transitions), taken under the lock.
